method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts, seat-neutral core (computations in nt-pit.l4, dated duties in nt-pit-duties.l4) with regulative rules where the text states duties, and a seat layer for the resident individual and the parent, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (non-residents, s 2.44 apportionment, years before 2005 and a negative amount taxable answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Income Tax Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.I-1, office consolidation dated 2023-11-23 (../../registers/source-bundle/income-tax.a.2023-11-23.txt); Income Tax Regulations, R.R.N.W.T. 1990, c.I-1, consolidation dated 2025-06-02 (../../../income-tax-regulations/registers/source-bundle/income-tax.r1.2025-06-02.txt); 2026 thresholds from the Canada Revenue Agency page of 2026-06-25 (../../registers/source-bundle/cra-tax-rates-brackets-2026.txt). English version; the French is equally authoritative.

scope: Resident individuals, 2005 and later years (2026 thresholds deposited, other years' thresholds and every indexed credit amount as inputs): ss 2(1)(a), 2.1, 2.11(2)-(7), 2.14, 2.15, 2.16, 2.2, 2.21, 2.22, 2.24(1) (adults), 2.25, 2.26, 2.28, 2.29, 2.32; NWT Child Benefit ss 3.1, 3.2(1), (2), (2.1), 3.3(1), (3) with Regulations s 1.1; Cost of Living Offset s 3.5(1)-(3) with Regulations s 1.2; s 11 (federal s 150(1)(d), (1.1)(b)); ss 16(1), 17. Out: non-residents and s 2.44; ss 2.12, 2.17-2.19, 2.23, 2.24(1)(c)(i), 2.24(2), 2.3, 2.31, 2.34-2.43; s 3; Child Benefit special cases and elections; s 3.6; corporations; ss 5, 6, 6.1, 15; payroll withholding.

the parent claiming the NWT Child Benefit and the Cost of Living Offset
